metadata.name: bordrless_swap
metadata.description: The Bordrless DEX: constant-product pools between Bordrless Token Standard mints with Uniswap-v4-style hooks (before and after swaps and liquidity changes, with return deltas and dynamic fees), virtual reserves for launch curves, LP tokens on BTS and protocol fees.

instructions.name: collect_protocol_fees
docs: Admin: moves the accrued protocol fees of a pool (always in its quote token) to the fee
collector's quote holding. The remaining accounts are the quote mint's token-hook slice
(`quote_hook_accounts` of them, its program first).

points of the cuts, taken in the quote (base-side cuts valued at the swap's own price). 0
under the flat model.

docs: 0 base → quote (a sell), 1 quote → base (a buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Exact input.

docs: The least the recipient's holding must gain.

types.name: Swapped
docs: A swap. The input side: the hook's `deltas_in` and `burn_in` left the trader's input holding
first, then the rest, of which `received_in` reached the vault (`cuts_in` is what the hooks
took on the way: the pool hook's deltas and any token-hook cut). The output side: the curve
gave `amount_out`; the protocol fee stayed in the quote vault; the hook's `deltas_out` and
`burn_out` left the output vault; the rest went to the recipient's holding, which gained
`delivered_out` (`cuts_out` is what the hooks took on the way).

fields.name: recipient
docs: The owner of the holding the output was delivered to.

fields.name: direction
docs: 0 base → quote (sell), 1 quote → base (buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: What the trader put in, before the hook's cuts.

fields.name: deltas_in
docs: Sent from the trader's input holding by the hook's `before_swap` answer, in order.

fields.name: burn_in
docs: Burned from the trader's input holding by the hook's `before_swap` answer.

fields.name: cuts_in
docs: What the hooks took from the input and someone received, in the input token:
`amount_in - burn_in - received_in` (the pool hook's deltas, plus any cut the input mint's
own hook took from those transfers).

fields.name: received_in
docs: What arrived in the input vault.

fields.name: lp_fee
docs: In the input token; stays in the pool.

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: Always in the quote token. Flat model: on a buy from `received_in`, on a sell from
`amount_out`. Share model: the pool's share of `cuts_in` and `cuts_out` (base-side cuts
valued at this swap's price), each rounded up.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: What the curve gave (before any protocol fee taken from the output).

fields.name: deltas_out
docs: Sent from the output vault by the hook's `after_swap` answer, in order.

fields.name: burn_out
docs: Burned from the output vault by the hook's `after_swap` answer.

fields.name: cuts_out
docs: What the hooks took from the output and someone received, in the output token: the pool
hook's deltas, plus any cut the output mint's own hook took from those transfers and from
the delivery.

fields.name: delivered_out
docs: What the recipient's holding actually gained.
